name: Day Attention Operations
intent: A calm person-facing operational surface that keeps current work, calendar relations, and explicit reminders visible without flattening them into one task list.

witnesses.notes: Internal visual witness established with the first Day-to-Day implementation. Preserve separation of attention streams and restrained operational density.

layout.shape: current attention first, supporting local systems below
layout.grouping: work, calendar, and reminders remain distinct
layout.primary_action: activation remains available without being required for passive visibility
layout.refresh: quiet automatic refresh; no disruptive animation

controls.advanced_options: defer until the relation requires them

typography.hierarchy: current attention and time relations scan before supporting detail

avoid: notification noise without an admitted reminder or source relation
calendar density that implies every relation is a rigid appointment
adaptation_rules: Keep Calendar as time truth and Day-to-Day as attention; do not visually merge their state models.
Keep source-system work identifiable rather than rewriting everything as a local task.
Make current attention visible without requiring an activation click.
Activation words enter the same state rather than creating a parallel view.
Prefer readable time and referent context over decorative status treatment.

review.notes: Approved initial internal visual template for the person-facing day-attention layer.
